Completed the `critic-truth` stage. The native Goal was activated, passed the binding guard, and completed; its receipts are saved in the stage directory.

The critique flags four precision points: explicitly roll back the outer SQLite transaction after statement errors, handle `SQLITE_BUSY` at commit as an active transaction, keep the WAL version floor conditional on the actual mode and concurrency pattern, and distinguish full-file sampling from full-file validation. These findings are grounded in the [SQLite conflict](https://www.sqlite.org/lang_conflict.html), [SQLite transaction](https://www.sqlite.org/lang_transaction.html), [SQLite WAL](https://www.sqlite.org/wal.html), and [DuckDB CSV detection](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/data/csv/auto_detection) documentation. No parser or database tests were run.
